desktop.middle_column: Main Conversation View + Header + Interactive Composer (flex-1)
desktop.right_column: Collapsible Thread / Members / Shared Files Sidebar (300px)

mobile.structure: Genuine Mobile Navigation with Bottom Bar & Sheet Drawer
mobile.flow: Workspace/Channel Drawer -> Main Conversation View -> Collapsible Info Sheet
mobile.composer: Sticky bottom bar with safe-area padding and expandable attachment drawer

workspace_switcher.style: Vertical icon rail with active indicator bar, rounded-2xl avatars, tooltip on hover, create workspace '+' button
workspace_switcher.active_state: ring-2 ring-indigo-600 ring-offset-2 scale-105 rounded-xl transition-all

message_bubble.grouping_rule: Messages sent within 5 minutes by the same user group under 1 avatar header.
message_bubble.received_message: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm text-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-3.5 space-y-1 max-w-[85%]
message_bubble.sent_message: bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-3.5 space-y-1 max-w-[85%] ml-auto
message_bubble.hover_actions: Absolute floating bar on top-right: Emoji Reaction, Reply in Thread, Bookmark, More Options
message_bubble.reactions: Inline pills with emoji + count, e.g., '👍 3' with indigo active outline

presence_indicator.badge: absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white

typing_indicator.style: flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium italic
typing_indicator.dots_animation: Three animated pulsing indigo dots (...) with subtle spring motion

composer.container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-sm focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-indigo-500 transition-all
composer.toolbar: flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 text-slate-500
composer.actions: Formatting tools (Bold, Code block, Mention '@', Attach file, Emoji picker, Voice note) + Primary 'Send' button with paper plane icon

collaboration_dashboard.note: NO KPI CARDS, NO CHARTS, NO REVENUE STATS
cards: Quick Quick-Action Jump Grid ('Start Huddle', 'Share Code Snippet', 'Invite Teammate')

image_urls.description: Hackathon teammate profile photo (male in hoodie)

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, channel items, message bubbles, avatars, modals) MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the light theme specs: pure white surfaces (#FFFFFF), warm slate canvas (#F8FAFC), crisp borders (#E2E8F0), and one signature Indigo accent (#4F46E5).
Do NOT create black/dark-blue analytics dashboard views with financial KPI charts.
Make the conversation experience feel responsive, interactive, and polished with typing indicators, emoji reactions, read receipts, and file attachments.
Ensure standard JS component modularity without relying on TS types.
Apply data-testid to every interactive component for easy verification.
